13.1.32.
----------

China Merchants Seamen Resume Work

The Shun Pao and other local newspapers publsih
the following report :-
    In compliance with the notice issued by the
China Merchants Seamen Double Pay Demand Group,
all the seamen resumed work yesterday. The steamers
berthed at the Kinleeyuan wharf left the harbour yesterday.
    The office staff of the Company held an
emergency meeting at 3 p.m. yesterday at which they
decided to send a telegram to the National Government
requesting that director Kuo Wei Fong be retained in
office. The telegram will be drafted by twelve men
and will be dispatched toOmorrow morning.
    In order to secure confirmation of the
Press report about the agreement concluded between the
Company and the seamen's representatives, a reporter of
the Sin Seng News Agency yesterday called on the responsible
officers of the Company and was told that the four demands
were settled between the mediators and the Seamen's
representatives but theCompany had made no expression
in this matter.
    The China Merchants Seamen Double Pay
Demand Group yesterday submitted the agreement to the
Municipality of Greater Shanghai, the Shanghai Special
District Kuomintang, the Bureau of Social Affairs and
the Shanghai Navigation Bureau of the Ministry of
Communications, for registration.

招商局海员复工

《申报》及其他本地报纸刊登如下报道：
    遵照“招商局海员要求双薪团”发布的通告，
所有海员于昨日复工。停靠在金利源码头的轮船已于昨日离港。
    该公司职员于昨日下午3时召开紧急会议，决定
向国民政府发送电报，请求留任董事郭维丰（Kuo Wei Fong）。
该电报将由十二人起草，并于明晨发出。
    为证实关于公司与海员代表达成协议的媒体报道，
新生通讯社记者昨日拜访了公司负责人，获悉四项诉求
已在调解人与海员代表之间解决，但公司方面对此事
未作表态。
    “招商局海员要求双薪团”昨日将协议提交至
大上海市政府、上海特别区国民党党部、社会局以及
交通部上海航政局，以备备案。

C.M.S.N. Company - Strike of seamen ended
Following a promise made by Tu Yueh Shen to guarantee
the fulfillment of the conditions agreed to on January 11
the seamen of the above mentioned Company resumed
operations and ships commenced their sailings on January
12.
Kwe Wei Feng, the Commissioner of the Company,
owing to the financial straits of the company and the
insubordinate attitude adopted by the seamen, has
tendered his resignation and the affairs of the Company
are now managed by Bao Kung Fan, Chief of the General
Affairs Department.

招商局轮船公司 - 海员罢工结束

Extract from Intelligence Report 12.1.32.

C.M.S.N. Company - Mediation meeting - Seamen to resume
to-day January 12

The mediation meeting which was held on January 11
was continued by representatives of both the Company and
the seamen and the mediators including Messrs. Tu Yueh
Shun, Yu Ya Ching and Li Tsun Wu at the residence of the
first named 216 Rue Wagner, between 5 and 9 p.m. January
12 when the following conditions were agreed upon and it is
reported that the steamers will resume their sailings from
to-day, January 12 :

1. That half of the bonus equivalent to one month's wages
be paid at the end of January and the other half at the
end of March.

2. That the Company accept in full the seamen's demands No.
2, 3 and 4 resolved on January 10 which refer to treatment
for seamen on a par with that accorded to the clerical
staff, no dismissal without good reason and recognition of
the seamen's Union by the Company.

1月11日举行的调解会议由公司及海员双方代表
以及包括杜月顺（Tu Yueh Shun）、虞洽卿（Yu Ya Ching）和李尊武（Li Tsun Wu）先生在内的调解人继续举行，

China Merchants Accept Seamen's Demands : Director Resigns
The Shun Pao and other local newspapers publish the
following report :
At a meeting held at 5 p.m. yesterday by the mediators
Yu Yah Ching, the local shipping magnate, Doo Yueh Sun:, the
prominent resident in the French Concession, and two others,
in Doo's residence, the following four demands submitted by
the seamen of the China Merchants Steam Navigation Company
were accepted by the management :-
1. That the new year bonuses be paid in stalments i.e.
a half month bonus be paid in January and the other
half in March.
2. That same treatment be accorded to the office-staff and
the seamen.
3. That no seaman be dismissed without reason.
4. That as the Employees Union and the Five Wharves Workers
Union are recognized by the Company, the Seamen's
Federation must likewise be accorded recognition.
A circular notice was issued at 6 p.m. yesterday
by the Seamen's representative announcing their victory and
requesting them to be ready for work. The fifteen vessels
which have been idle in habour for five days will be made ready
for sailing to-day.
Yeseteday Kuo Wai Fong, the Managing Director of
the Company, tendered his resignation to the National
Governemnt. He states that the financial difficulties of
the firm and the labour unrest are seriously handicapping
the development of the Company.

招商局接受海员诉求：董事辞职

《申报》及其他本地报纸刊登如下报道：
在昨天下午5时由调解人、本地航运巨头虞洽卿（Yu Yah Ching）、
法租界知名人士杜月孙（Doo Yueh Sun）及另外两人，
在杜氏寓所举行的会议上，管理层接受了
招商局轮船公司海员提出的以下四项诉求：
1. 新年奖金分期支付，即一月份支付半个月奖金，
三月份支付另一半。
2. 给予职员和海员同等待遇。
3. 不得无故解雇任何海员。
4. 既然公司已承认雇员公会和五码头工人公会，
海员联合会也必须得到承认。
海员代表于昨日下午6时发布通告，宣布胜利，
并要求他们准备上岗。已在港口闲置五天的十五艘船只
将于今日做好航行准备。
昨日，公司总经理郭外丰（Kuo Wai Fong）向
国民政府提出辞职。他表示，公司的财务困难
和劳工动荡严重阻碍了公司的发展。

Strike
The Office of China Merchants Seamen : The New Terms

The following report appears in the Shun Pao and
other local newspapers:-

At a meeting held yesterday, the striking seamen of
the China Merchants Steam Navigation Company decided to
detail 2 representatives to call on the mediator,
Doo Yuet Son, to discuss the following terms:-

1. That the company issue double pay at the year end.
2. That the Seamen's Federation be recognized.
3. That all seamen be given similar treatment as that
accorded to the office staff.
4. That no seaman be dismissed without reason.
5. That the year-end bonus of one month pay be issued
every year.

Doo Yuet Son informed the callers that the first
three demands may be granted by the company, but the last
two must be discussed with the Managing Director Kuo Wei
Foong.

At a meeting held at 2 p.m. yesterday at No.38
Avenue Edward VII, the seamen decided to form a China
Merchants Seamen Federation. The arrangements are now
under way.

In addition to the five river steamers and eight sea
going vessels which are now idle in harbour, two other
sea going steamers which arrived in port yesterday have also
been tied up.

At 8 p.m. yesterday, the seamen's delegates were again
summoned to Doo Yuet Son's home to meet Yu Yah Ching, the
company's deputy. The conference proved futile.

A third manifesto was issued by the seamen yesterday.

罢工
招商局海员办事处：新条款

《申报》及其他本地报纸刊登如下报道：

在昨日举行的会议上，招商局轮船公司的罢工海员
决定指派2名代表拜访调解人杜月孙（Doo Yuet Son），
讨论以下条款：

1. 公司在年底发放双薪。
2. 承认海员联合会。
3. 所有海员享有与职员相同的待遇。
4. 不得无故解雇任何海员。
5. 每年发放一个月工资的年终奖金。

杜月孙告知来访者，前三项诉求公司可能会答应，
但最后两项必须与总经理郭维丰（Kuo Wei Foong）商讨。

在昨日下午2时于爱德华七世大道38号举行的会议上，
海员决定成立招商局海员联合会。相关安排
正在进行中。

除了目前停泊在港内的五艘内河轮船和八艘海轮外，
昨日抵港的另外两艘海轮也被扣留。

昨晚8时，海员代表再次被召至杜月孙家中，
与公司副手虞洽卿（Yu Yah Ching）会面。会议证明毫无结果。

海员昨日发布了第三份宣言。

January 10, 19..
Morning Translation

The Man Pao and other local newspapers
publish the following report:-
Several steamers of the China Merchants
Steam Navigation Company arrived in Shanghai yesterday and
have been tied up by their seamen who have joined the
strike. Other vessels arriving here will also be tied up
in a similar manner.
As has been said, the Shipping has
assured the striking seamen that he would be responsible for
securing their demand for double pay. The seamen have agreed
to man one of the vessels for Ningpo. If the dispute is
not settled, the vessel will again be tied up. A notice
to the above effect was issued to all seamen at 4 p.m.
yesterday.
An express letter denouncing the director
of the Company and explaining the reason of their strike
has been dispatched to the Ministry of War by the seamen.
The representatives of the seamen were
summoned to see Yuen Sung's house at 7 p.m. yesterday to
discuss a settlement but up to the time of going to press,
the conference was still in progress.
The Company yesterday sent a letter to
the Municipality of Greater Shanghai requesting it to mediate.
A notice has also been issued by the Company exhorting the
striking seamen to resume work in order not to obstruct
communications.

THE STRIKE OF FEMALE WORKERS IN JAPAN CHINA MILL.

The Man Pao and other local newspapers
publish the following report:-
The 300 female workers of the Japan-
China Cotton Mill, Yangtszepoo, who went on strike last year,
are now working in Chinese cotton mills. They are being
given financial support by the workers in the other
departments of the Mill.
The 5th District Weavers Union yesterday
issued a notice to all local weavers asking support for
the female strikers.

FRENCH COUNCIL DISCUSSES BIG BUILDINGS.

The Man Pao and other local newspapers
publish the following report:-
In order to reduce the number of
unemployed, the French Municipal Council last year discussed
this item. The Chinese Members Union of the Council
made an appeal to the Municipality of Greater Shanghai
against this unreasonable dismissal. The Chinese
Municipality lodged a protest with the Council on December
8, but there has been no reply from the Council.
Yesterday the Public Works and Communications
Committee of the Council discussed this item. It was
decided that other conditions would be taken into the
account.

------

The Strike of China Merchants Seamen

The Shun Pao and other local newspapers publish
the following report:-

The entire body of seamen of the China Merchants
Steam Nagivation Company held a conference yesterday
morning at which they decided to act in a united manner and
not to conduct secret negotiations with the management of
the company. The strikers will work on the ships as
usual but no vessel will be manned for a voyage.

Each of the six departments of the seamen
has detailed a representative to proceed to the Municipality
of Greater Shanghai, the Bureau of Social Affairs and the
District Kuomintang to appeal for support and to submit a
petition giving the reasons of their strike. The represen-
tatives were persuaded not to act against law and order.

In view of the serious situation, Kuo Wei Foong,
Director of the Company, yesterday called a meeting
to discuss measures to cope with the trouble. It was decided
to detail a representative to the seamen to tender an apology
on behalf of Kuo for having given a rude reply the day before.
As to the demand, the Company will agree to issue half
month's wages to all seamen as reward.

The seamen were not satisfied. The negotiations
thus came to a deadlock. At the request of the seamen,
Mr. Doo Yueh Sung will mediate to-day.

The loss to the Company is estimated at $10,000 a day!

招商局海员罢工

《申报》及其他本地报纸刊登如下报道：

招商局轮船公司全体海员于昨晨举行会议，决定采取统一行动，不与公司管理层进行秘密谈判。罢工海员将照常上船工作，但任何船只均不配备人员出海航行。

海员工会的六个部门各指派一名代表，前往大上海市政府、社会局及区党部请求支持，并提交请愿书陈述罢工理由。这些代表被劝告不得做出违反法律与秩序的行为。

鉴于局势严重，公司总经理郭维藩（Kuo Wei Foong，音译）昨日召开会议，讨论应对此次纠纷的措施。会议决定指派一名代表向海员转达郭氏的歉意，为其前一日给出的粗鲁答复致歉。至于诉求方面，公司同意向所有海员发放半个月工资作为奖励。

海员对此并不满意。谈判因此陷入僵局。应海员请求，杜月笙先生将于今日进行调解。

估计公司每日损失达10,000美元！

C.M.S.N.Co. - strike of seamen
The 700 seamen employed on seven steamers of the
C.M.S.N.Co. who struck work on January 7, 1932 were
joined on January 8 by 600 more employed on seven other
vessels which arrived at Shanghai on that date.
About 10 representatives of the strikers held a
meeting in the China Marine Officers' Guild, 38 Avenue
Ed. VII, at 3 p.m. January 8 and decided to request Tu Yueh
Shen, Chinese member of the French Municipal Council,
to mediate in the dispute.
At 10a.m. January 9 five representatives of the
strikers called at the local Kuomintang Headquarters
and the Social Bureau with a request for assistance
in the dispute. At both places, they were promised that
full consideration would be accorded to their request.

招商局轮船公司（C.M.S.N.Co.）——海员罢工
1932年1月7日罢工的招商局轮船公司七艘轮船上的700名海员，在1月8日得到了另外七艘于当日抵达上海的轮船上的600名海员的加入。
约10名罢工代表于1月8日下午3时在爱多亚路（Avenue Ed. VII）38号的中国海员公会举行会议，决定请求法公董局华董杜月笙调解此次纠纷。
1月9日上午10时，五名罢工代表前往当地国民党党部和社会局，请求协助解决纠纷。在两处，他们均获承诺将对他们的请求给予充分考量。

January 8, 1932. Morning Translations.

The China Press and other local newspapers publish the following report:-
The office-staff of the China Merchants Steamship Navigation Company were given double pay for December last year. All the seamen, sailors and firemen on the vessels owned by the Company then demanded a similar bonus but this was rejected by Director Ho Yu Foong.
At 9 a.m. yesterday twelve seamen representing the crews of the twelve steamers of the Company in port, interviewed the Director and renewed the demand. This was again rejected on the ground that the treatment seamen were receiving better treatment than the office-staff, so that the granting of double pay to the office-staff & only fair and the seamen's claim for similar treatment was entirely unreasonable. The Director declared that if the seamen insisted on their demand, he would resign.
The representatives then returned and reported the result of the interview to their comrades who at once proceeded to the various seamen and pilots associations and had a conference. Subsequently, they formed a China Merchants Seamen's Double Pay Demand Group and detailed representatives to draft a manifesto asking for public support.
It was resolved not to work the twelve vessels in harbour unless their demand is granted. All vessels of the Company arriving in port will be tied up by the men.
The six steamers which were to have left port yesterday have cancelled their departure. Fares have been returned to passengers and cargo unloaded. The situation is very serious.

SMF
8/1

1932年1月8日。晨间译文。

《字林西报》及其他本地报纸刊登如下报道：
招商局轮船公司的职员获得了去年12月份的双薪。该公司所属船只上的所有海员、水手和司炉工随后要求类似的奖金，但遭到总经理何玉丰（Ho Yu Foong，音译）的拒绝。
昨日上午9时，代表公司在港十二艘轮船船员的十二名海员会见了总经理，再次提出该要求。这一要求再次被拒，理由是海员所受的待遇优于职员，因此给予职员双薪是公平的，而海员要求同等待遇则完全不合理。总经理声明，如果海员坚持其要求，他将辞职。
代表们随即返回，将会见结果报告给同事，同事们立即前往各个海员和引水人协会举行会议。随后，他们组成了“招商局海员要求双薪团”，并指派代表起草宣言以争取公众支持。
会议决议，除非其要求得到满足，否则不操作停泊在港内的十二艘船只。公司所有抵港船只将被船员扣留。
原定于昨日离港的六艘轮船已取消行程。票款已退还乘客，货物已卸载。局势非常严峻。

SMF
1/8
